summary: This note is a short biographical entry on Obi Emelonye, described as a former professional footballer and law professional. It traces his education: a BA (Hons) in Theatre Arts from the University of Nigeria, Nsukka (1990), an LLB Law degree from the University of Wolverhampton (1998), and a postgraduate degree in Legal Practice from London Metropolitan University (2002). It notes he practised law for a few years before turning to his first love, film.
one_line: Obi Emelonye is a former footballer and law professional with theatre and law degrees who later turned to filmmaking.
key_facts: Obi Emelonye is described as a former professional footballer and law professional.
Obi Emelonye graduated from the University of Nigeria, Nsukka, with a BA (Hons) in Theatre Arts in 1990.
Obi Emelonye went on to study for an LLB Law degree from the University of Wolverhampton, completed in 1998.
Obi Emelonye completed a post-graduate degree in Legal Practice from London Metropolitan University in 2002.
Obi Emelonye practised law for a few years after his legal training.
Obi Emelonye later focused on his first love, film.
